item.title: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
item.description: Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.
item.content:encoded:
Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.

item.title: With jet fuel prices near a record, holiday airfares soar higher
item.description: If you're planning to fly this holiday season, be prepared to pay more than you did last year. The price of jet fuel — one of airlines' biggest expenses — is close to an all-time high in the U.S.

item.title: What if you gave yourself a day to cancel all the plans you dread?
item.description: It's a day to think about all the upcoming appointments and commitments you're dreading — and then decline some of them. Writer Caroline Sylge shares a suggested schedule for the day.
